subject: [PATCH v8 16/30] fs/proc: account PMD swap entries in smaps

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch updates the smaps functionality in the Linux kernel to correctly account for PMD swap entries. It introduces a new function, smaps_account_swap(), which is called when a swapped-out THP is encountered. This function calculates the correct Swap and SwapPss values based on the swap reference counts of each slot in the PMD entry. The patch also updates the smaps_pte_entry() and smaps_pmd_entry() functions to use this new function, ensuring that device-private PMD entries are treated as fake-present and allowing for accurate PSS and private/shared accounting.
